By creating an account or otherwise accepting these Terms, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not create an account or book or offer services. The Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled; acknowledging it is not blanket consent to optional processing.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility and accounts
paragraphs: You must be at least 16 years old to create a customer account and book services. Customers aged 16 or 17 may book both online and in-person sessions, but may not offer services. You must be at least 18 years old to act as a provider.

LifeSwap does not impose a blanket parental-permission requirement on customers aged 16 or 17. This does not override applicable law: you must have the legal capacity and any legally required consent for the particular booking, payment, or other activity. If those conditions cannot be met, you may not undertake that activity. Payment providers have their own age and eligibility rules; LifeSwap's 16+ customer policy does not authorize opening an underage PayPal account or using another person's payment account without authorization.

Provide accurate account information, protect your sign-in credentials, and notify us of suspected unauthorized access. Do not impersonate another person, misrepresent your qualifications, evade a suspension, or allow others to misuse your account. You are responsible for your conduct and for use you authorize, subject to applicable law.

sections.heading: 3. How LifeSwap works
paragraphs: LifeSwap lets members browse service listings, book sessions, communicate about bookings, and apply to offer services. Providers create and manage their listings and availability. The platform supports free sessions and paid sessions through the connected checkout website.

Providers are responsible for delivering their listed services. LifeSwap provides the marketplace and related account, booking, messaging, and moderation functions. Provider approval is permission to list on the platform, not a guarantee of identity, qualifications, suitability, or results. Nothing here removes obligations LifeSwap itself has under applicable law.

Sessions may take place online or in person. Review the description and confirm the meeting format, time zone, meeting place or call link, and any requirements with the provider before the session. Share meeting details only as necessary. Messaging and calendar links help coordinate sessions; the app does not itself provide a built-in video-call or recording service. Do not record another participant without the permission and legal basis required for that recording.

sections.heading: 4. Listings and provider obligations
paragraphs: Providers must describe their services, prices, experience, and availability accurately, offer only services they are permitted and competent to deliver, and hold any legally required qualifications or permissions. Do not claim a background check, certification, endorsement, or guaranteed outcome that has not actually been established.

Providers must respect confirmed bookings, communicate material changes promptly, and use the cancellation process when unable to deliver a session. Providers are responsible for their applicable business, licensing, and tax obligations, without limiting obligations that the law places on LifeSwap.

Customer payments are received into Itay Simchai's PayPal account. Itay reviews and approves transactions, and provider payment is scheduled for the agreed session day before the session starts, subject to a valid booking and any applicable cancellation or refund. LifeSwap's customer service fee is added to the session price rather than deducted from the provider's listed price. No additional provider deduction is authorized by these Terms unless separately disclosed and agreed or required by law.

Payment to a provider before the session does not remove the provider's delivery obligations or a customer's refund rights. Providers must cooperate in resolving cancellations and non-delivery. Any arrangements for recovering already-transferred funds must comply with applicable law and the provider's agreed payment arrangements; customer refund rights are not conditional on successful recovery from a provider.

sections.heading: 5. Bookings and payment
paragraphs: Review the provider, service, session date and time, price, currency, and any disclosed charges before confirming. Confirm the time zone with the provider if it is unclear. A selected slot is not a confirmed booking until LifeSwap reports successful confirmation. A free booking requires successful confirmation without payment.

In the mobile app, paid bookings open LifeSwap checkout in a browser, where you may need to sign in again and select the date and time again. PayPal processes supported payments under its own terms. Merely opening checkout or authorizing an incomplete payment does not guarantee a booking.

For a paid booking, LifeSwap adds a customer service fee of 5%-10% of the listed session price. The rate varies by provider profile and prominence. The exact percentage, fee amount, session price, and total must be disclosed before the customer authorizes payment. The fee is not a deduction from the provider's listed price. Free sessions carry no percentage-based service fee.

For example, a $100 session with a 10% service fee costs the customer $110: $100 for the provider's session and $10 for LifeSwap. This example does not change the currency or amount shown in your checkout. Any applicable taxes must be disclosed as required by law before payment.

The applicable amount and currency must be shown at checkout before you authorize payment. Your payment provider may impose currency-conversion or other charges under your agreement with it. Contact us if a charge succeeds without a corresponding confirmed booking.
These Terms do not introduce a subscription or recurring membership charge. Any future recurring product would require separate, clear disclosure and authorization.

sections.heading: 6. Cancellations and refunds
paragraphs: The following standard rules apply to the total paid for a booking, including the LifeSwap service fee, subject to any stronger mandatory consumer rights:
Provider cancellation: a 100% refund of the session price and service fee.
Customer cancellation at least 24 hours before the scheduled start: a 100% refund of the session price and service fee. Exactly 24 hours qualifies for the full refund.

Customer cancellation less than 24 hours before the scheduled start: a 50% refund of the session price and service fee. The other 50% is retained under the cancellation policy, including compensation for the provider's reserved time.
Customer no-show without advance notice: no refund of the session price or service fee, subject to mandatory rights and any established non-delivery by the provider.
Provider no-show: a 100% refund of the session price and service fee. A provider's failure to deliver is not treated as a non-refundable customer no-show.
For a $100 session plus a $10 service fee, a full refund is $110 and a 50% refund is $55. A free session has no money to refund.

Use the booking cancellation action and retain the confirmation. If you cannot complete that action, promptly email nadrty8@gmail.com with the booking details and your cancellation notice. Any legally required cancellation channels remain available. Refund timing depends on the payment provider and applicable law; an exact processing time is not guaranteed by these Terms.

Report no-shows, a disputed notice time, service non-delivery, or a payment error with the booking details so the circumstances can be reviewed. The lateness of a participant, a technical interruption, or a service-quality complaint is not automatically a no-show. The cancellation schedule does not create a right to cancel a completed and delivered session retroactively.

Mandatory consumer protections, including any applicable withdrawal rights, cancellation channels, refund deadlines, and remedies for non-delivery or defective services, take priority over this schedule. No service fee or cancellation deduction will apply where prohibited by applicable law.

sections.heading: 7. Messages, safety, and acceptable use
paragraphs: Use messaging to communicate respectfully and coordinate legitimate services. Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, send spam, publish unlawful or infringing content, solicit payment credentials, or expose another person's private information without a lawful basis.

Do not use LifeSwap for fraud, unsafe or unlawful services, exploitation, malware, unauthorized access, interference with the platform, or attempts to bypass access controls. Do not submit misleading listings or reports.

Use the reporting tools or contact nadrty8@gmail.com to report an issue. Provide accurate details. Reporting does not guarantee a particular outcome, and the service is not an emergency-response channel. For an immediate emergency, contact the appropriate local emergency service.

sections.heading: 8. Your content and others' information
paragraphs: You retain any ownership rights you have in your profile, listings, messages, and other content. You give LifeSwap a non-exclusive license to host, store, reproduce, display, and transmit that content only as needed to operate, support, and protect the service. This is not a license to use private conversations in advertising.

You must have the rights and permissions needed for content you submit or link to. Respect other users' confidentiality and use information received through a booking only for legitimate service-related purposes or another lawful, authorized purpose.

The operational license ends when the relevant content is removed, except as needed for lawful retention, resolving an existing matter, and limited backup handling described in the Privacy Policy. Copies already received by another participant cannot necessarily be recalled.

sections.heading: 9. Moderation, suspension, and leaving
paragraphs: We may investigate reports, remove listings or content, or restrict accounts when reasonably necessary to address violations, fraud, security issues, or legal obligations. Where appropriate and lawful, we will explain the decision and allow you to contact us about an error. Urgent protective action may occur before notice.

You can stop using LifeSwap and initiate account deletion in Account > Profile & Settings. Deletion does not itself cancel pending sessions, trigger a refund, erase every shared record immediately, or eliminate obligations already incurred. Resolve open bookings and contact us about outstanding payments or data requests.

Any continuing retention of personal information is subject to the Privacy Policy and applicable law. Provisions that need to continue to resolve an existing payment, dispute, or legal obligation survive account closure only to the extent necessary.

sections.heading: 10. External services and app license
paragraphs: Payment, calendar, linked portfolios, image hosts, and other external services are operated by third parties and may have their own terms and privacy practices. You decide whether to use optional links. LifeSwap remains responsible for its own obligations, including those that cannot be transferred to another provider.

You receive a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the app for its intended purpose, subject to these Terms and applicable app-store rules. LifeSwap and its licensors retain rights in the app and branding. This does not restrict uses that applicable law expressly permits.

For an app downloaded through Apple, applicable Apple usage rules and the applicable Apple standard end-user license agreement govern the app license to the extent relevant. Apple is not the provider of sessions booked through LifeSwap, and purchases are not endorsed by Apple.

sections.heading: 11. Availability and responsibility
paragraphs: We aim to keep the platform functioning, but availability can be affected by maintenance, network failures, and third-party outages. We do not promise uninterrupted access or that a provider's service will produce a particular career, financial, or other result.

To the extent permitted by law, the platform is provided as available, and LifeSwap is not responsible for losses caused solely by another user's independent conduct or circumstances beyond its reasonable control. Responsibility for a claim depends on the applicable law and the facts.

Nothing in these Terms excludes liability for fraud, intentional misconduct, or any liability, warranty, duty, or consumer remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. No blanket liability cap, mandatory arbitration, or class-action waiver is introduced by this draft.

sections.heading: 12. Disputes, changes, and contact
paragraphs: For a dispute, contact nadrty8@gmail.com with the relevant account and booking details. We will try to resolve the issue, but contacting us does not prevent you from exercising statutory remedies or contacting a regulator.

These Terms are governed by the laws of Israel to the extent permitted by applicable law. This choice does not deprive a consumer in another country of mandatory protections applicable to that consumer. Any rights to bring a claim before a court or authority available under applicable consumer law remain unaffected. These Terms do not impose exclusive court jurisdiction or mandatory arbitration.

We may update these Terms for changes to the service or applicable requirements. We will identify the effective date and provide notice of material changes where required. Changes will not retroactively reduce rights in an existing confirmed booking, and we will obtain renewed agreement where required.
